newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NUTRICIA PROBES FRIESLAND DAIRY LINK.
newsitem.headline: NUTRICIA PROBES FRIESLAND DAIRY LINK.

text.p: Food group Nutricia NV said on Thursday it was investigating the possibilities of combining some activities with Friesland Dairy Foods Holding NV or transferring some activities between the companies.
"The probe will, among other things include possible forms of cooperation between the firms in the areas of consumer products in the Netherlands and Belgium," Nutricia said.
The companies will also explore the possibility of transferring production and marketing of dairy products in Germany, the Czech Republic, Poland and Hungary from Nutricia to Friesland Dairy Foods.

"The turnover of the consumer products of Nutricia which are involved totals 600 million guilders," the company said. It added it was also looking at taking over Friesland's baby and clinical food activities, with turnover of 100 million guilders.
The discussion fits with both companies' strategy of further concentration on core activities, Nutricia said.
It said the discussions were at such a stage that it could not give any further details or make any prediction about the outcome of the talks.
Nutricia said it aimed to conclude the discussions bu the end of January 1997.
